hero_title: No Indian brand should grow alone.
hero_text: Zeroing is a community of homegrown Indian brands and the people behind them. We open doors for each other. Our podcast and our research lab write down how the work really gets done.

bands.title: The community
bands.text: Brands that stand together, like stalls in one lane. One brand's customer finds the next. One founder's supplier helps another.

bands.title: Independent Society
bands.text: Our podcast. One person at a time, one long honest conversation about what their working life in India actually looked like, from the inside.

bands.title: The Other Details
bands.text: Our research lab. The money, the paperwork, the years nobody saw. Written down, with sources.

craft_text: Turmeric before it is a gel. A camera on the sand for a shot of ants. The making, the hands, the years. Every photograph here comes from a brand in the community, a guest, or our own shoot.

brands_title: Made here, by people you can meet.
brands_text: Homegrown and made in India, as each founder tells us. Every brand keeps its own shop. Buy from them directly.
how_text: Three things we look after. Every brand, episode and study answers to them.

pillars.title: Nature
pillars.line: We give time to the people who look after it.
points: Independent Society begins with a wildlife filmmaker who has spent two decades on the species few channels commission.
Brands build on what grows here: turmeric, saffron, honey, coffee, orange.
The Other Details traces what our habits cost the land, like the water behind the cloud.

pillars.title: Culture
pillars.line: We keep what India already made.
points: Vedi Kade carries Tamil history into clothes for an ordinary day.
INDSO starts from haldi doodh, made in Indian kitchens for generations.
Every episode opens with Nehru's midnight speech of August 1947.

pillars.title: Sustainability
pillars.line: We ask every brand for one honest next step.
points: We call no brand sustainable. Each brand page shows what its founder says it does now on materials, packaging or making, and what comes next. Where the founder has not said, the page says so.
Brands meet each other's suppliers, stalls and customers. Fewer of them build alone.
We grow at the makers' pace, one founder conversation at a time.
